shop_about_story_headline: Architectural Depth, Handcrafted in Layered Wood
shop_about_story: STEREOWOOD began with a fascination for architectural models—the way solid structures interact with open space, light, and shadow. While studying at university, I began wondering whether that sense of architectural depth could be transformed into wall art: something sculptural and intricate, yet warm enough to become part of an everyday living space. That idea led to my first experiments with layered wood. By cutting, stacking, shifting, and assembling multiple sheets, a flat drawing gradually became a dimensional composition. Each layer changes the way light moves across the artwork, creating shadows and details that reveal themselves from different angles. Today, every STEREOWOOD piece begins in our studio with an original design and a carefully planned layer structure. The individual layers are precision laser-cut, assembled and finished by hand, inspected, and securely packed for international delivery. Our designs draw inspiration from nature, geometry, architectural ornament, and Eastern symbolism. From trees of life and koi fish to mandalas and celestial patterns, each piece is created to bring depth, meaning, and visual presence to a space. What began as a small six-layer experiment has grown into a collection of statement wall art for homes, offices, meditation spaces, and meaningful gifts. We also offer selected size and color customization, allowing each artwork to feel more at home in its final setting. We hope STEREOWOOD brings more than decoration to your wall—a sense of craftsmanship, depth, and quiet wonder. Thank you for supporting our work.

shop_about_story: Welcome to my little shop here on Etsy! My name is Amy, and I’m the proud owner of Lulu Bean Designs. "Lulu Bean" has been my nickname for my daughter ever since she was a baby—though I’m not sure where it came from, it just stuck! Creating has always been a passion of mine. My husband and I decided to embrace a new adventure and bought a second home on the Gulf Coast in Houma, Louisiana. We now divide our time between Richmond, Virginia—our hometown—and our new spot in Louisiana. shop_about_story_headline: About Design of Gift
shop_about_story: DesignOfGift creates premium laser-ready artwork for makers, engravers and creative businesses. We specialize in high-quality SVG, DXF, PNG and PDF designs for laser engraving, CNC cutting, plasma cutting and digital crafting. Our collections include wildlife art, vintage maps, gothic decor, rustic farmhouse designs, patriotic artwork and custom engraving files. Every design is carefully prepared with clean details and engraving-friendly layouts to help your projects cut and engrave smoothly on Glowforge, xTool, CO2 and Fiber laser machines. Our goal is simple: Create unique digital artwork that looks professional, engraves cleanly and helps makers create products that stand out.
